name: fix-db-semantics-perf
title: P2:本地DB语义与查询性能
description: 报告db.rs七项中五项合并(check-db全CONFIRMED)。语义:(1)SearchOptions::default exclude_trashed=false(db.rs:102),search/list/stats(1329-1394五条SQL)默认含回收站;改默认排除+--include-trashed。(2)resolve_collection_id(db.rs:1508-1522) key=?OR collectionName=? 单行无ORDER BY,同名不确定;改key优先+0/1/多分支+ambiguity报错。(3)get_notes N+1(db.rs:325);改批量tag加载。性能:(4)search(db.rs:189-281)全量HashSet候选+全量水合+内存排序后才skip/take;改SQL下推ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET+批量关联聚合。(5)find_duplicates(db.rs:1114-1197)硬编码limit 10_000静默漏检+标题双层循环Levenshtein O(N²);改DOI SQL grouping+标题blocking(前缀/年份/作者)+去silent cap改显式budget/truncated meta。(6)graph全库usize::MAX加载+clique展开(db.rs:1281,graph.rs:212-214),max_group_size仅整组丢弃;支持edge budget+预聚合+truncation meta。(7)重查询统一spawn_blocking(现仅PDF走run_pdf,annotation/graph/workspace的rusqlite直接跑Tokio worker)。基准:golden dataset结果等价+10k/50k synthetic benchmark。
